column3: Overcast rainy afternoon. Flat, soft, cool grey-blue daylight with no direct sun and no sunlight patch on the floor; grey cloudy sky through the window with rain streaks on the glass; colours slightly desaturated and cooler; desk lamp switched on with a small warm pool of light, other lamps off.

Golden hour just before sunset. Low, strong orange-pink sunlight streaming through the window, long warm light shapes across the floor and up the far wall, deep violet-mauve shadows, sky through the window glowing peach to pink. Lamps and fairy lights still off.

Night, lights ON. Deep blue-indigo night sky with a moon and a few stars through the window. The room is dim blue-violet in the shadows but richly lit by its own lights: fairy lights glowing warm along the wall, floor lamp on with a warm cone of light, desk lamp on with a pool of light on the desk, and a soft cool glow spilling from the (still empty) monitor screen onto the keyboard and chair. Cozy, magical, high contrast between warm lights and cool shadows.

Night, all lights OFF. Deep blue-indigo night sky with a moon and stars through the window. The room is dark and quiet in blue-violet tones, lit only by cool pale moonlight falling through the window as a soft blue-white patch on the floor. Fairy lights, floor lamp and desk lamp are all off; monitor dark. Objects remain readable as dark silhouettes with subtle blue rim light.

Early morning just after sunrise. Soft, hazy, pale pink-and-gold light entering low through the window, gentle long light shapes, cool lilac-blue shadows, slightly misty and fresh; sky through the window pale pink fading to light blue. All lamps off.

The WORK DESK against the wall. The desktop monitor is centred and faces the viewer nearly straight on, its screen a large flat dark completely empty rectangle with nothing on it (a UI is composited later), taking up a good part of the picture. Around it: keyboard, drawing tablet and stylus, green desk lamp, spotted mug, pencil cup, stacked books with a small plant, sticky notes and abstract art prints pinned on the wall above, fairy lights along the top, the edge of the teal office chair with a crocheted blanket over it in the foreground.

The YARN AND CRAFT TABLE. Wooden table with woven baskets of yarn balls, a granny-square crochet blanket in progress with a crochet hook in it, embroidery hoop, scissors, small patterned sewing box, pegboard on the wall above with thread spools, pens and scissors, a small wall shelf with trailing plant, a wooden stool. Include several clearly separate objects (a yarn basket, the crochet piece, the embroidery hoop, the sewing box, the pegboard) spaced apart so each can become its own clickable item.

The tall wooden BOOKSHELF seen nearly front-on, filling the frame. Shelves of books with blank spines, sketchbooks, a row of green ring binders, storage boxes, woven baskets with rolled paper tubes, a small terracotta pot, a ceramic bowl, a wooden rainbow toy, a glass bottle, trailing plants on top. Leave the items grouped per shelf so each shelf reads as its own clickable collection.

The WINDOW with its wide wooden sill, seen from inside, nearly front-on. Sheer white curtains pulled to the sides, four-pane wooden frame, blue sky with soft clouds and leafy branches outside, hanging plant beside it, a tall plant in a spotted pot on the floor to the right. The sill is wide and has a clear empty spot in the middle where a cat will sit, plus a small plant and a mug at one end. The glass area should be large and clear, because a cat will appear outside it later.

A sprite sheet of ONE small chubby ginger-and-cream tabby house cat with a white chest and green eyes, in four poses arranged in a 2 by 2 grid with generous empty transparent space between them (each pose stays fully inside its own quarter of the image): top-left sitting upright facing the viewer with tail curled; top-right walking in side view facing right, mid-step; bottom-left leaping in side view facing right, body stretched in mid-air; bottom-right asleep curled into a round loaf. The same cat, same colours and proportions, in all four.

A fluffy grey-and-white neighbourhood cat seen from the front, standing up on its hind legs with both front paws raised and pressed flat as if against a pane of glass, one paw mid-tap, big curious yellow eyes looking straight at the viewer, pink nose. Whole body visible down to the hind feet and tail.
A set of six small floating musical notes and sparkles, loosely scattered and well separated, painted in cream, terracotta, sage and lavender brush strokes.
